name: pre-edit-path-strict-through-a-character-class-is-denied
description: cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#209: a policy pattern without '**' is matched as fnmatch matches it, where '[...]' is a character class. tracked.yaml holds 'data/**' and strict_mode.yaml's only entry is 'data/[0-9].json', so data/5.json is strict through the class [0-9] alone, and A's pre-edit after peer B's commit is denied as stale, as in fixture 05. Read with '[' as a literal, the strict pattern names only the file data/[0-9].json, so data/5.json falls through to warn mode, where the pre-edit is allowed with a collision warning against B's grant, as in warn_mode fixture 36. Both backends.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: data/5.json was updated by agent 814dac78 at <TS>. Re-read data/5.json via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
